list.title: Hello, Python
list.subtitle: Your first programs, and how Python reads them
list.goal: Write and run your first Python programs, print text and numbers, and read an error message without fear.

list.title: Variables: names for values
list.subtitle: Give your data a name, and change it as your program runs
list.goal: Store values in well-named variables, update them as a program runs, and check what type of value each name holds.

list.title: Numbers and maths
list.subtitle: Integers, decimals and the operators behind every app
list.goal: Do real calculations with int and float, the seven arithmetic operators, precedence, rounding and the math module.

list.title: Strings I: text in Python
list.subtitle: Quotes, escapes, indexing and slicing
list.goal: Create and combine strings, and pull out any character or slice of text by its position.

list.title: String methods and f-strings
list.subtitle: Clean messy text and format output like a pro
list.goal: Clean and analyse text with string methods, and produce polished, aligned output with f-strings.

list.title: Input and type conversion
list.subtitle: Programs that listen to the user
list.goal: Write interactive programs that read user input, convert it to the right type, and spot bad input before it crashes the program.

list.title: Decisions with if
list.subtitle: Teach your program to choose
list.goal: Make programs choose between paths using comparisons, logical operators and if, elif and else.

list.title: Loops I: while
list.subtitle: Repeat until the job is done
list.goal: Repeat work with while loops, control them with counters, sentinels, break and continue, and avoid accidental infinite loops.

list.title: Loops II: for and range
list.subtitle: Loop over anything, a set number of times
list.goal: Use for loops over strings and ranges, apply the accumulator and counting patterns, and build nested loops for tables and patterns.

list.title: Project: Command-line games
list.subtitle: Design and build a complete number-guessing game
list.goal: Plan a program before coding it, then build a complete, replayable number-guessing game using everything from Days 1 to 9.

list.title: Lists: many values, one name
list.subtitle: Create, change and loop over collections
list.goal: Store collections of data in lists, change them in place, and loop over them to compute totals, counts and extremes.

list.title: Lists II: sort, search, copy
list.subtitle: Order your data and dodge the aliasing trap
list.goal: Sort and search lists, number items with enumerate, build grids, and copy lists safely instead of aliasing them.

list.title: Tuples and unpacking
list.subtitle: Fixed records and elegant assignments
list.goal: Use tuples for fixed records, unpack them into readable names (including star-unpacking), and pair lists with zip.

list.title: Dictionaries: look it up
list.subtitle: Store data by name, not by position
list.goal: Store and look up data by key with dictionaries, update them safely, loop over them, and count things with the counting pattern.

list.title: Nested data and sets
list.subtitle: Real-world data shapes and lightning-fast membership
list.goal: Work with nested, JSON-shaped data, group and rank records with dictionaries, and use sets for uniqueness and group comparisons.

list.title: Comprehensions
list.subtitle: Transform and filter data in one clear line
list.goal: Build new lists, dicts and sets with comprehensions that transform and filter data, and know when a plain loop reads better.

list.title: Functions I: write it once
list.subtitle: Define, call and return like a pro
list.goal: Write your own functions that take parameters and return values, and combine small functions into bigger ones.

list.title: Functions II: flexible and safe
list.subtitle: Defaults, keyword arguments, scope and a famous trap
list.goal: Write flexible functions with defaults, keyword arguments, *args and **kwargs, and keep them safe with pure design and correct defaults.

list.title: Errors and exceptions
list.subtitle: Programs that handle bad input without crashing
list.goal: Read deep tracebacks, handle specific exceptions with try/except/else/finally, raise your own errors, and validate input so programs never crash.

list.title: Project: Expense tracker CLI
list.subtitle: Put Phase 2 together in a real command-line app
list.goal: Design and build a menu-driven expense tracker that stores a list of dicts, uses small functions, and handles every bad input without crashing.

list.title: Modules and imports
list.subtitle: Borrow superpowers, organise your own code
list.goal: Import from the standard library, split your code into your own modules and packages, and structure scripts with a main guard.

list.title: Files I: reading and writing
list.subtitle: Give your programs a memory
list.goal: Read, write and append text files safely with with-blocks and pathlib, and analyse a log file line by line.

list.title: Files II: CSV and JSON
list.subtitle: Spreadsheets, APIs and saved app state
list.goal: Read and write CSV and JSON files, convert between them, and save and load app state safely.

list.title: OOP I: classes and objects
list.subtitle: Design your own types
list.goal: Design and write classes with __init__, attributes and methods, and use objects that enforce their own rules.

list.title: OOP II: Pythonic classes
list.subtitle: Objects that print, compare, sort and validate
list.goal: Make classes behave like built-in types with dunder methods, properties, class attributes, class methods and static methods.

list.title: OOP III: inheritance and composition
list.subtitle: Families of classes, and objects built from parts
list.goal: Share behaviour with inheritance and super(), write polymorphic code, enforce contracts with abstract base classes, and choose composition when it fits better.

list.title: Iterators and generators
list.subtitle: Process endless data with almost no memory
list.goal: Explain the iteration protocol, write generators with yield, and build lazy pipelines that process big files one item at a time.

list.title: Functional tools
list.subtitle: Functions as values, closures and caching
list.goal: Pass and return functions, sort with key functions and lambda, use map, filter and zip, build closures, and apply functools tools.

list.title: Decorators and context managers
list.subtitle: Add behaviour to any function, and guarantee cleanup
list.goal: Write decorators (with and without arguments) using functools.wraps, and build context managers with classes and contextlib.

list.title: Project: Library management system
list.subtitle: Classes, rules and JSON persistence in one real system
list.goal: Design and build an object-oriented library system with borrow and return rules, custom exceptions, JSON persistence and a report.

list.title: The standard library's power tools
list.subtitle: collections and itertools: batteries included
list.goal: Replace hand-written loops with collections and itertools: count, group, queue, combine and accumulate data like a senior developer.

list.title: Dates and times
list.subtitle: Timestamps, time zones and the maths of calendars
list.goal: Create, format, parse and calculate with dates and times, and convert safely between UTC and IST.

list.title: Regular expressions
list.subtitle: Find, validate and extract text patterns
list.goal: Write regular expressions to search, validate, extract and clean text, and know when a simpler tool is the better choice.

list.title: Type hints, dataclasses and enums
list.subtitle: Make your code say exactly what it means
list.goal: Describe data precisely with type hints, model records with dataclasses, and name fixed choices with enums.

list.title: Testing I: unittest
list.subtitle: Prove your code works, and keep it working
list.goal: Write automated tests with assert and unittest that pin down normal behaviour, edge cases and errors.

list.title: Testing II: test-driven development
list.subtitle: Red, green, refactor, and faking the outside world
list.goal: Drive new features with tests first, write pytest-style tests, and isolate code from time, randomness and networks with unittest.mock.

list.title: Debugging and logging
list.subtitle: Find bugs systematically and let your code report what it does
list.goal: Debug systematically, read tracebacks through nested calls to the real cause, and replace print debugging with proper logging.

list.title: Clean code
list.subtitle: Write Python other developers enjoy reading
list.goal: Recognise messy code and refactor it, step by step, into clean PEP 8 Python with clear names, constants, guard clauses and small functions.

list.title: Environments and packages
list.subtitle: pip, venv, pyproject and a project layout that scales
list.goal: Set up isolated Python projects with venv and pip, pin dependencies, lay out a project professionally, and reason about versions in code.

list.title: Project: Bank system with tests
list.subtitle: Dataclasses, exceptions, logging and a test suite, together
list.goal: Design and build a tested, logged banking core with dataclasses, enums and custom exceptions, using the whole Phase 4 toolkit.

list.title: Big-O and performance thinking
list.subtitle: Count the steps before you count the seconds
list.goal: Predict how code slows down as data grows, confirm it with timeit, and choose data structures that keep programs fast.

list.title: Searching, sorting and recursion
list.subtitle: Find it fast, put it in order, and think in smaller problems
list.goal: Implement linear and binary search, three classic sorts and recursive functions, and know when Python's built-ins beat them.

list.title: Data structures you build
list.subtitle: Stacks, queues, linked lists, hash maps and heaps from scratch
list.goal: Build a stack, a queue, a linked list, a hash map and a priority queue yourself, and know which one each problem needs.

list.title: Graphs, trees and dynamic programming
list.subtitle: Model connections, walk them, and stop repeating work
list.goal: Model real problems as graphs and trees, search them with BFS and DFS, and speed up recursive solutions with dynamic programming.

list.title: Working with data
list.subtitle: Clean it, summarise it, report it
list.goal: Turn a messy CSV export into clean records, honest statistics, grouped totals and a readable text report.

list.title: HTTP and APIs
list.subtitle: How apps talk to each other
list.goal: Understand HTTP requests and responses, build safe URLs, and parse, paginate and retry real-world JSON APIs.

list.title: Build your own API
list.subtitle: Routes, handlers and JSON responses, from scratch
list.goal: Build a JSON API from scratch, with routing, path parameters, validation and status codes, as a real WSGI app you can test without a server.

list.title: Databases with SQL
list.subtitle: Store, query and protect your data with sqlite3
list.goal: Create and query a SQL database from Python: filter, group, join, update safely in transactions, and never fall for SQL injection.

list.title: Async and concurrency
list.subtitle: Do more while you wait
list.goal: Write async code that overlaps waiting with gather, tasks, timeouts and semaphores, and choose between asyncio, threads and processes.

list.title: Project: Data dashboard CLI
list.subtitle: Load, clean, analyse and report, from the command line
list.goal: Build a command-line sales dashboard that cleans a messy CSV, computes KPIs, ranks products, prints ASCII charts and takes argparse filters.

list.title: Automation scripts
list.subtitle: Let Python do the boring work, safely
list.goal: Write file automation scripts with pathlib, shutil and argparse that plan first, dry-run by default and are ready to schedule.

list.title: Web scraping and parsing
list.subtitle: Turn web pages into clean data, responsibly
list.goal: Extract links, names and prices from HTML with html.parser, resolve URLs correctly and scrape within ethical and legal limits.

list.title: A taste of data science
list.subtitle: numpy, pandas and the road to machine learning
list.goal: Use numpy arrays and pandas DataFrames to select, filter and group data, fit a first model, and choose the right data tool for a job.

list.title: Design patterns in Python
list.subtitle: Proven designs, without the ceremony
list.goal: Apply SOLID, strategy, factory, observer, adapter and dependency injection the Pythonic way, and know when a pattern is overkill.

list.title: Architecture of real applications
list.subtitle: Layers, config, errors and logs that scale
list.goal: Structure an application into interface, service and data layers with settings, a clear error strategy and module loggers.

list.title: Performance and profiling
list.subtitle: Measure, find the hot spot, fix it, prove it
list.goal: Find real bottlenecks with timeit, cProfile and tracemalloc, then fix them with better data structures, caching, generators and join.

list.title: Security essentials
list.subtitle: Habits that protect your users
list.goal: Defend Python apps against injection, unsafe eval, weak password storage, guessable tokens, leaked keys and risky dependencies.

list.title: Capstone I: Task manager core
list.subtitle: Design and build the heart of a real app
list.goal: Design and build the core of a task manager: dataclass models, a validating service layer, JSON storage and a unit test suite.

list.title: Capstone II: Ship it
list.subtitle: From working code to a real product
list.goal: Turn the task manager core into a shippable product: an argparse CLI, reports, logging, packaging, Git, CI and deployment.

list.title: Graduation: You are a Python developer
list.subtitle: Career paths, portfolio and interview practice
list.goal: Choose a career path, plan a portfolio, and solve classic live-coding problems the way interviewers want to see them.
